body.name: Face-robust exact rational Airy tube prior
body.construction:
For integers \(n,k\geq1\) and rational \(\varepsilon>0\), put
\[
 \gamma_v^\pm=\lambda_v^\pm-3p_0^\dagger,
 \qquad
 \gamma_d^\pm=\lambda_d^\pm-2p_0^\dagger,
 \qquad
 \gamma_0=\delta_{111}-\delta_{000}.
\]
For \(x\in\operatorname{supp}(w_k^\dagger)\), \(h,\zeta\in[-\varepsilon,\varepsilon]\), with either sign used when a coordinate is zero, define
\[
 p_{n,x,h,\zeta,t}^{\dagger,\mathrm A}
 =p_{0,t}^\dagger+\alpha_n\left\{
 |x|\gamma_{v,t}^{\operatorname{sign}(x)}
 +|h|\gamma_{d,t}^{\operatorname{sign}(h)}
 +\zeta\gamma_{0,t}\right\}.
\]
Draw \(X^\dagger\) with density \(w_k^\dagger\), and draw \(H^\dagger\) and \(Z^\dagger\) independently of it and of each other with density \(\rho_\varepsilon\).  Conditional on these coordinates, draw \(m\sim\operatorname{Multinomial}(n,p_{n,X^\dagger,H^\dagger,Z^\dagger}^{\dagger,\mathrm A})\), and then draw a labeled schedule uniformly in its response-count orbit.  Integrating on the finitely many rational spline pieces and the eight sign cells defines \(\nu_{n,k,\varepsilon}^{\dagger,\mathrm A}\).  The admissibility condition for this construction is
\[
 \alpha_n(3T_k^\dagger+4\varepsilon)\leq1.
\]
